subject: psychology

moments.title: Human Memory: A Proposed System
moments.who: Richard Atkinson and Richard Shiffrin, Stanford
moments.body: Atkinson and Shiffrin formalise the multi-store model: sensory register, STS, LTS with rehearsal-based transfer.
moments.takeaway: Boxes-and-arrows became the visual grammar of cognitive psychology.

moments.title: Glanzer and Cunitz serial position
moments.body: Free recall shows primacy and recency; delay removes recency but not primacy, supporting two stores.
moments.takeaway: Behavioural dissociations support architectural distinctions in memory.

moments.title: Patient HM described
moments.body: Henry Molaison's bilateral medial temporal lobectomy leaves short-term but not new long-term declarative memory.
moments.takeaway: A single patient can constrain a whole theoretical framework.

now.title: Beyond the multi-store model
now.body: Working memory replaced unitary STM. LTM is subdivided into episodic, semantic and procedural systems.

reflection: The Atkinson-Shiffrin diagram is still drawn in textbooks because it is teachable, not because it is current.
